Giffard Park Primary School
Welcome to Giffard Park Primary School
Headteacher's Welcome
A warm welcome to Giffard Park Primary School.
We are a dedicated, hard-working, friendly staff team who all work very closely to support children's growth and learning.
Giffard Park is a local authority Primary School, that caters for Early Years Foundation Stage (3-5 years old), which includes a pre-school and reception classes, Key Stage 1 (5-7 years old) and Key Stage 2 (7-11 years old).
We have high expectations, inclusive approaches and aim for Giffard Park to be an inspirational and exciting place of learning – a place where all children strive to achieve their full potential within a supportive and caring community. We firmly believe in our mission statement: 'Enjoy, Aspire, Achieve' and encourage children to take responsibility for their own learning and to develop skills which make them lifelong learners.
Our rich, broad and balanced curriculum aims to encourage children to develop the skills they need in later life with a strong focus on pupils embedding learning from the breadth of the curriculum into their long-term memory. We track our children’s progress very carefully and ensure that everyone knows their next steps for learning. We also consider the whole child and aim to develop individuals who will make a positive contribution to society and are able to live by our SMART values as well as the core British values.
Our co-curriculum offer compliments the core curriculum and provides opportunities for all pupils in wider enrichment activities, such as clubs, visits and visitors, which ensures pupils leave us in Year 6 ready to succeed in the next stage of their education and to relish future opportunities and challenges.
I hope you find our website informative and helpful and that it gives you a feel of what Giffard Park can offer you and your child. However, the best way to get that feeling is to come and visit us in action! Please do get in touch and I will look forward to meeting you.
To arrange a visit or enquire about information that you may not find on our website, please contact Jady Jones in the school office on 01908 617868.
Thank you for visiting.

pageCache.pageTitle: Smart Steps Pre-School | Giffard Park Primary School
pageCache.text:
Giffard Park Primary School
Welcome to Smart Steps Pre-School at Giffard Park Primary School.
Smart Steps at Giffard Park is a Pre-School for 3 and 4 year olds, with all the benefits of being attached and managed by Giffard Park Primary School and with a fully qualified teacher.
We have a newly refurbished stimulating environment both inside and outside in the school grounds where children are supported to be creative, imaginative, curious, and independent. We provide an exciting and ambitious curriculum enabling children to develop their knowledge and understanding of the world, their vocabulary, early phonics, and maths skills. The curriculum has strong links to the school’s curriculum supporting their learning and transitions into school. We work hard to support children’s social interactions and enjoy watching them build early friendships and relationships with others.
Our staff are an experienced enthusiastic team who provide a happy, secure, and friendly environment. They work in partnership with parents and carers to build on the child’s early learning experiences. Providing a wealth of enriching activities including the use of our sensory room, forest school sessions, cooking, gardening, music, visits to the library and many more.
We offer morning, afternoon or full-time sessions everyday day during term time.
Morning session (08:30 - 11:30) £18.60
Lunch session (11:30 - 12:30) £6.20
fternoon session (12:30 - 15:30) £18.60
Full day £43.40 (7hours)
Snack £1 per week voluntary contribution
* lunch session must be booked as part of a morning or afternoon session.
Smart Steps at Giffard Park accept both private and funded children. All 3 or 4-year old children in England are entitled to 570 hours free child care or early education per year, which equates to 15 hours per week, for 38 weeks each year during term time. Some 3 or 4-year old children will be eligible for 30 hours funded sessions. Children can be registered and start pre-school when they turn 3. Funded sessions begin the term after they turn 3 years old. Until then they can be paid for privately.
More information can be found https://www.gov.uk/30-hours-free-childcare
Smart Steps at Giffard Park will accept most major Childcare Vouchers or payment through the Government Tax-Free Childcare scheme. Please enquire with the School Office for further details. To register your child or to enquire further and to obtain an application pack, please contact the office at Giffard Park Primary School on 01908 617868 or email school@giffardpark.milton- keynes.sch.uk

pageCache.text:
Giffard Park Primary School
Breakfast and After School Club
Premier Education Wraparound Care at Giffard Park School School
For more than 20 years, Premier Education has been delivering high-quality provision to primary schools nationwide, offering physical education, holiday camps, and a wide range of extra-curricular activities across both sporting and non-sporting subjects.
In 2016, we expanded our services to include wraparound care, bringing together our expertise in active, engaging provision with a convenient and seamless experience for parents. Our commitment to creating healthy, active, and enriching environments has made us the trusted choice for a growing number of schools.
Our Wraparound Provision
Running every day the school is open, end of school day until 6:00 pm, our wraparound care offers a safe, fun, and nurturing environment that both children and parents can trust.
What Premier Education Wraparound Offers:
Engaging Activities – From gymnastics to gardening, children can enjoy a wide variety of fun, active, and stimulating experiences.
Nutritious Meals & Snacks – A balanced menu designed to meet school food standards.
Easy Online Booking – A straightforward system with instant confirmation, helping parents manage sessions effortlessly.
Responsive Support – Our friendly team is available by phone or email, ensuring quick and helpful responses to any queries.
Flexible Scheduling – Book up to 1:00 PM on the same day, perfect for last-minute changes.
Stress-Free Refunds – With our ‘Flexi Bookings’ option, parents can claim a no-questions-asked refund for any missed session.
We’re thrilled to be supporting families at Giffard Park Primary School and look forward to welcoming your child to Premier Education Wraparound Care!
Life at Our Wraparound Care
Our wraparound care offers a true home-from-home environment, where children can relax, recharge, and feel at ease after a busy school day. Whether they’d like some quiet time or prefer to dive into exciting activities, there’s always something to enjoy in our warm and nurturing environment.
Every session is packed with fun and creativity. Children can lose themselves in imaginative play, build amazing structures with Lego, K’NEX, and building blocks, explore their artistic side at our creative stations, while our end-of-week movie night—complete with popcorn—offers the perfect opportunity to unwind with friends.
Alongside free play, we provide an enriching programme of adult-led activities designed to spark curiosity and broaden horizons. From edible crafts and construction challenges to team games and global themes, our sessions inspire children to learn about the wider world in engaging, stimulating ways. They might create traditional art from different cultures, engineer international landmarks, or take part in group challenges inspired by customs from around the globe.
More than just a wraparound club, we’re a community. Whether your child joins us every day or just now and then, they’ll always feel at home here.
Timings & Prices for Wraparound Care
We provide flexible wraparound care designed to fit your family’s routine, offering a safe, engaging, and fun space for your child before and after school. Sessions run every day the school is open, with different pick-up times to suit your schedule.
Session Options & Pricing:
All sessions include a wide variety of activities, from creative play to team games, plus a healthy snack in line with school food standards. Children staying until 6:00 pm will also enjoy a light tea, served between 5:00 pm and 5:15 pm.
How to Book Our Wraparound Care
Booking your child’s place at Premier Education Wraparound Care is quick and easy. Simply visit Premier Education – Giffard Park to get started.
New to Our Services?
If you’re booking with us for the first time, you will need to create an account. As part of the registration process, we will collect some important details—such as medical and dietary information—so we can provide the best care and support for your child.
Booking Your Sessions
Once your account is created, simply log in, choose your sessions, and confirm your booking in just a few clicks. You’ll receive an instant email confirmation, making it easy to keep track of your child’s schedule.
Important Information
To maintain safe staff-to-child ratios, all sessions run on a first-come, first-served basis, with bookings accepted until 1:00 pm on the same day. We encourage booking early to guarantee your child’s place.
If you have any questions or need help with bookings, our friendly support team is here to assist. We look forward to welcoming your child to our wraparound care!

Holiday Camps – Fun & Engaging Childcare When School’s Out!
At Premier Education, we understand that school holidays can be a juggling act for busy parents—that’s why we provide exciting, high-quality childcare when schools are closed. Our holiday camps, running at venues across Milton Keynes, offer a safe and vibrant environment where children can stay active, make friends, and take part in a wide variety of activities.
As the UK’s leading provider of sport and physical activity, we deliver expert coaching and fun, engaging games at every camp. But the experience doesn’t stop at sport—children also enjoy arts & crafts, outdoor adventures, team challenges, and themed enrichment activities that spark creativity and curiosity.
With flexible booking options and a programme designed to suit different ages and interests, our holiday camps give parents peace of mind while offering children days filled with fun, learning, and new experiences.

Giffard Park Primary School Governing Body Information
Our Governors are a key part of the strategic leadership of the school and play a vital role in helping to ensure our children get the best from their time at Giffard Park Primary School.
Our Governing board are a diverse group of individuals with a broad range of professional and personal skills, experiences, and attitudes. They are a group of volunteers, who help set and dedicate themselves to the vision, values, and strategic direction of the school, maintaining the highest of standards, whilst encouraging continual forward planning and thinking in their drive for excellence. Together they share a common goal, which is to help the school provide our pupils with the best education possible.
Governors at the school have three main roles:
Effective governance is based on six key features:
They share responsibilities for monitoring and evaluating the performance of the school in delivering a fulfilling, broad and balanced education for all the children. The Governing Board meets at least 9 times throughout the school year: 1 Full Governing Board meeting, 1 Teaching, and Learning Committee meeting, and 1 Finance and Premises Committee meeting per term.
We have adopted The National Governance Association’s code of conduct. You can read it here:
Our Governors are elected, either by being nominated by staff or parents and then voted into position. Our Co-opted governors, are individuals from the community who have the skills and experience which the governing body require. They will be appointed by the existing board, following an interview.

Giffard Park Primary School
SPRING CLUBS
Each half-term there are a range of clubs on offer catering for a range of interests. Some take place during lunchtime whilst others are after school.
There is a mixture of paid clubs led by external companies (eg Premier Education) and free clubs led by staff members. Some clubs are open to anyone in the year group or key stage to attend whilst others are invite-only based on specific criteria.
In the coming months, Premier Education are looking to expand their reach of extra curricular clubs. Please find an update from them here:
Following the recent pilot of some new events and activities designed to enrich our wraparound provision, we’re excited to be launching some of these during the Summer Term at Giffard Park Primary. Examples from the pilot have included pottery, glow-in-the-dark dodgeball, and jewellery making. We’re really pleased with how these have been received and look forward to expanding the offer into more of our sites! As mentioned, please keep your eyes peeled for details of what we’ll be introducing in the new term.
Giffard Park Primary School

Summer 2025 Giffard Park Primary School Results Foundation Stage
At the end of the Foundation Stage children are assessed against each of the 17 Early Learning Goals (ELG). Children are assessed as either emerging, expected or exceeding in each of the ELGs and are considered to have reached a ‘Good Level of Development’ if they have achieved at least the expected level in:
At Giffard Park Primary School in the summer of 2025 70% of children achieved a Good Level of Development. The National Average figure was 68%.
the specific areas of mathematics and literacy.
Key Stage 1 Results, Phonics and End of Key Stage 1 Assessments
Children in Year 1 take a phonics screening check which checks how well children are able to read the sounds that letters and groups of letters make.
In 2025 80% of children achieved the expected standards in the phonics screening test; the national figure for 2024 was 80%.
Any children that do not achieve the expected standard in Year 1 re-take this assessment in Year 2. By the end of Year 2 in 2025, 50% of children who needed to retake had achieved the expected standard.
